_doc: Where to read each company's current openings. kind: html = list in the server HTML (curl/WebFetch is enough); js = list rendered by JavaScript (needs a headless browser); api = JSON or XML endpoint; rss = RSS search feed; postings = no usable list, check each posting URL from jobs.json; none = no public source found (LinkedIn post, mailto). closedText = wording shown when a posting is closed. keywords = search terms for large groups. Update listUrl/kind/notes after each crawl when a better source is found.

maersk.notes: Workday search API: POST JSON {"appliedFacets":{},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":"<keyword>"}. Posting detail: GET the same base + externalPath. The review linked R197299 (Freight Forwarding) by mistake; the wind role is R197106.

beyond-the-sea.notes: Zoho Recruit; 'STA -' = stage, 'ALT -' = alternance. Ignore 'Candidature spontanée'.

birmingham-city-university.notes: Post-doc on jobs.ac.uk (closes 2026-11-02); PhD on bcu.ac.uk/research/our-phds (closes 2026-11-25). Search jobs.ac.uk for 'wind assisted' for new ones.

bluefins.notes: Only a LinkedIn post; no website or job board found.

bound4blue.notes: Teamtailor. The review links LinkedIn, which needs a login.

bpifrance.notes: Single posting; still open if the apply button is shown.

bureau-veritas.closedText: Désolé, ce poste est déjà pourvu

bureau-veritas-marine-offshore.closedText: Désolé, ce poste est déjà pourvu
bureau-veritas-marine-offshore.notes: Same careers site as Bureau Veritas.

centrale-nantes.notes: Keep only LHEEA / ocean / naval roles.

chantiers-de-l-atlantique.closedText: L'offre que vous essayez d'afficher n'existe pas ou plus sur ce site
chantiers-de-l-atlantique.notes: 19 pages (~180 offers); keep Propulsion Vélique / SolidSail and decarbonisation roles. Closed postings redirect to accueil.aspx.

cma-cgm.notes: Replace the keywords in the URL. The search is fuzzy: check each result title. FR and EN versions of the same posting: keep the FR one.

crain.notes: No careers page; openings are posted as homepage news items.

dealfeng.notes: Only a LinkedIn post; company based in Tianjin, China.

genevos.notes: Each role has a status label before its title: 'job opening' = open, 'coming soon' = announced, not open yet. Job descriptions are PDFs; apply via careers@genevos.com.

iscc.notes: Personio XML feed; HTML board at https://iscc-system-gmbh.jobs.personio.de/. Keep marine-fuel roles.

james-fisher.notes: Paginated (5 pages, ~50 vacancies); read every page. Closed vacancies return HTTP 410.

orient-express.notes: Apply by e-mail only (mailto); no public posting found.

sinay.notes: Welcome to the Jungle, rendered by JavaScript: use a headless browser. sinay.ai/en/about-us/jobs/ lists nothing.

spinergie.notes: Careers page lists no roles; postings are LinkedIn-only.

stormgeo.notes: Returns 403 to bots; the same list is readable at https://stormgeo-web-next.vercel.app/careers. Keep maritime roles only (fleet / vessel performance, routing).

syroco.notes: Personio board (the /xml feed returns 404). It lists more roles than syro.co. Skip 'Unsolicited Application', 'Recueil' and untitled freelancer entries.

toqua.notes: Skip 'Spontaneous Application' and the generic 'Internship' page.

towt.notes: LinkedIn post only; towt.eu has no careers page. Applications: recrutement@newtowt.eu.

wisamo.notes: LinkedIn post only; wisamo.michelin.com has no careers section. Try recrutement.michelin.fr with 'WISAMO'.
